meta.title: Pago a Tempo · invoices paid on time
meta.description: Automatic WhatsApp and email reminders for overdue invoices, with MB WAY and Multibanco payment links.

home.title: Invoices paid on time, without awkward phone calls
home.subtitle: Pago a Tempo reads invoices from your invoicing software and sends polite WhatsApp and email reminders with a link to pay by MB WAY or Multibanco.

s1.title: Connect Moloni
s1.text: We import open invoices and customer contacts. You can also add invoices by hand.

s2.title: Automatic reminders
s2.text: Before the due date, then on day 1, 5 and 11 of delay. Weekdays only, 9:00–19:00.

s3.title: One-click payment
s3.text: Every reminder has a link to pay by MB WAY or Multibanco. The invoice marks itself paid.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.draft: Provisional version for the pilot phase.

who.p: Pago a Tempo is a pilot-phase service built in Coimbra. For the data of our business users' customers we act as a processor (GDPR art. 28): the business is the controller.

data.p: From your account: email and company name. From your company's customers: name, contact person, mobile, email, open invoices and messages sent.

why.p: Only to send invoice payment reminders and record payments on your company's behalf. We don't sell data or send advertising.

where.p: Database in the European Union (Supabase, Frankfurt). Sub-processors: Supabase, Cloudflare, Stripe (payments), Twilio or Meta (WhatsApp) and Resend (email).

keep.p: While the account exists. Deleting the company in Settings erases all its data immediately.

rights.p: Access, rectification, erasure and portability. Contact: yegortatarenko06@gmail.com. You can also complain to the CNPD.
